regime.summary: SBP hiked 100bp on 2026-04-27 to 11.5%, CPI has nearly doubled in three months to 10.91%, and the 6M bill yields 12.50%, above the policy rate, so the curve prices more hikes. Brent is up 46.9% in three months. The closest analogue (2021-22 hike cycle with CPI above the rate) says hold bills and set a return trigger. Hike base rate has n=2 only.

evidence.quote: Policy rate 11.5%; last MPC decision 2026-04-27: hike (+100bp)
CPI YoY 10.91% for 2026-04 (published by 2026-05-03); three months earlier (2026-01) 5.79%
6M T-bill minus policy rate +1.00pp (market pricing hikes)
rate up 800bp in ten months with CPI above it
Lesson: hold bills, and set a trigger to return.
